# FasterAdmin

> FasterAdmin builds operations systems that let a 20 to 50 person company
> handle more work without hiring for it. Based in Amsterdam, three people,
> no subcontractors. We connect the tools a company already uses, put AI only
> where a person would otherwise have to read something and decide, and keep
> the rest as ordinary testable code.

## What we do

- Build operations systems on n8n, Airtable and Supabase, inside the tools a
  client already has open. No new software to learn, no data migration.
- Put AI where judgement is needed (reading an email, classifying a request,
  extracting from a document) and deterministic code everywhere else.
- Stay on through hypercare after go-live, then optionally on retainer.

## How an engagement works

1. A free 20 minute call, no pitch.
2. A paid scope, EUR 1,500 fixed, delivered within five working days of one
   working session. The client owns the document outright.
3. A fixed-price build, quoted at the scope and held through delivery, with a
   go-live date in writing.
4. Two to four weeks of hypercare after go-live.

## Who it is for

Service businesses of roughly 20 to 50 employees, usually owner-led, where the
work has outgrown how it is organised. Common trigger: a role they cannot fill.
